items.headline: NFL Week 5: Big takeaways, questions and fantasy spin from Sunday's games
items.description: Our NFL Nation reporters react to all the action, answering the biggest questions coming out of each Sunday game. Here's what we learned from Week 5.

items.headline: Mike Evans stars in 49ers' win: 'Exactly why he's here'
items.description: Mike Evans had seven catches, 113 yards and a touchdown to push the unbeaten Niners (5-0, 3-0 NFC West) to a rousing 32-29 victory over the Seahawks.

items.headline: 49ers move to 5-0 after thrilling win over the Seahawks
items.description: 49ers move to 5-0 after thrilling win over the Seahawks

items.headline: Judging overreactions to NFL Week 5: Time for Titans to look for another QB?
items.description: Is Cam Ward already on the hot seat? Is the NFC East doomed to mediocrity (or worse)? We're judging Week 5 overreactions.

items.headline: Brock Purdy leads 2 late scoring drives to deliver a 32-29 win for the 49ers over the Seahawks
items.description: — When the game was on the line and San Francisco's struggling offense needed to move the ball, Mike Evans stepped up and showed why the 49ers went after him so hard this offseason.

items.headline: 49ers lose WR Deebo Samuel to hamstring injury vs. Seahawks
items.description: The 49ers ruled out Deebo Samuel due to a hamstring injury in the third quarter, leaving San Francisco with just three healthy wideouts to finish Sunday's game vs. the Seahawks.
